interpretation_guardrails.multiple_simultaneous_propositions_cavea: Unlike LetterEnv (zero-or-one active proposition), FlatWorld permits more than one proposition to be simultaneously true; atom-contact counts are not directly comparable to LetterEnv's without accounting for that.
interpretation_guardrails.primary_interpretation: P_sat reports satisfaction frequency; provenance distinguishes continuation status, logical support, and operational non-success classes.
